name: noirbykriszta
description: Noir by Kriszta — Lash Stylist weboldal (Next.js + Express + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.prod:migrate: docker compose exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prod:seed: docker compose exec backend node prisma/seed.js
scripts.backup:db: docker compose exec -T db pg_dump -U noir noirbykriszta > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql
